---
title: "APOE"
format: html
editor: visual
---

```{r}
#| echo: false

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# ---- Read data ----
filtered_combined_post_QC <- read.csv(
  "~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/AD/BiomarkerProject2024/NewAlamarDataAugust2025/Alamar_QC_Protocol/R_Code_Dev/Alamar_Biomarker_QC_Repo/Metadata_Merge/output_files/filtered/filtered_combined_post_QC.csv"
)

# ---- Clean APOE genotype ----
apoe_clean <- filtered_combined_post_QC$APOE.geno |>
  trimws() |>
  gsub("\\s+", "", x = _)

apoe_clean[apoe_clean == ""] <- NA

filtered_combined_post_QC$APOEgeno <- factor(
  apoe_clean,
  levels = sort(unique(apoe_clean))
)

# QC check
str(filtered_combined_post_QC$APOEgeno)
table(filtered_combined_post_QC$APOEgeno, useNA = "ifany")

# ---- Pretty ggplot: APOE4_minus_APOE by genotype ----
p <- filtered_combined_post_QC %>%
  filter(!is.na(APOEgeno), !is.na(APOE4_minus_APOE)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = APOEgeno, y = APOE4_minus_APOE, fill = APOEgeno)) +
  geom_boxplot(
    outlier.shape = NA,
    alpha = 0.6,
    width = 0.65
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.15,
    size = 1.5,
    alpha = 0.5
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "APOE Genotype",
    y = "APOE4 − APOE",
    title = "APOE4 − APOE by APOE Genotype"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
  )

p

# ---- Identify extreme outliers within each genotype (1.5 × IQR) ----
apoe_outliers <- filtered_combined_post_QC %>%
  filter(!is.na(APOEgeno), !is.na(APOE4_minus_APOE)) %>%
  group_by(APOEgeno) %>%
  mutate(
    Q1 = quantile(APOE4_minus_APOE, 0.25),
    Q3 = quantile(APOE4_minus_APOE, 0.75),
    IQR = Q3 - Q1,
    lower = Q1 - 3 * IQR,
    upper = Q3 + 3 * IQR
  ) %>%
  filter(APOE4_minus_APOE < lower | APOE4_minus_APOE > upper) %>%
  ungroup()

# QC summary
table(apoe_outliers$APOEgeno)

# ---- Write outliers to file ----
write.csv(
  apoe_outliers,
  file = "APOE4_minus_APOE_extreme_outliers_by_genotype.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

# ---- Optional: highlight outliers on plot ----
p +
  geom_point(
    data = apoe_outliers,
    aes(x = APOEgeno, y = APOE4_minus_APOE),
    color = "red",
    size = 2
  )
```
